exposure: College and above education of pregnant women
Antenatal Care (ANC) visit during current pregnancy
Perceived susceptibility and severity of pregnancy and delivery complication
Intention (preference) of pregnant women for place of delivery
cohort: The study included 393 pregnant women in their 2nd and 3rd trimesters from Debre-Markos town, east Gojam Zone, Amhara Region, North West Ethiopia.
finding: Age (15-19 years), higher education, ANC visits, perceived severity of complications, and intention for institutional delivery were significant predictors of institutional delivery service utilization.
